editorialSummary.heading: Plan for semester-end dismissals and hurricane reserve dates
highlights: Ten shortened dates: four professional-development days and six semester-end days
Winter return January 5; spring return March 23 after a professional day
November 23-24 and March 15-16 are hurricane make-up reserves
paragraphs: Hernando has two different early-release patterns to plan around. Professional development shortens August 28, September 25, January 29 and February 26. The district also lists three shortened days at each semester end: December 16-18 and May 26-28. Dismissal times vary by school. Hernando High, for example, releases at 11:20 a.m., while Central, Nature Coast, Springstead and Weeki Wachee release at 11:10 a.m.

Travel plans for Thanksgiving and spring break need an extra check. The named breaks are November 23-27 and March 15-19, but the first two weekdays of each are hurricane make-up reserves. They are currently planned without student classes and may change if the district uses them. March 22 is a separate teacher professional day after spring break, putting the scheduled student return on Tuesday, March 23.

Winter Break runs December 21-January 1, followed by a student-free professional day January 4. Students are scheduled back January 5. Later in March, the Friday labeled Long weekend falls on March 26, after three scheduled class days March 23-25. The final school day is May 28 with early release; teacher post-school dates in June do not add student classes.

about.dataSource: The currently linked 2026-2027 Student Calendar and separate 2026-2027 Approved Bell Times. The student PDF matches the supplied local file by SHA-256. Both documents were reviewed visually alongside their text. The current Teacher Calendar was used only to corroborate student-free professional days and shortened dates.
about.processing: The green student grid marks attendance; unshaded March 22 is a teacher professional day, not a student class date. PreSchool August 4-7 and 10 is staff preparation, not a preschool student session. Exclude staff first day, pre/post-school preparation, employee payroll holidays and Memorial Day after the student year. Keep full student-free professional days October 12, October 30, January 4 and March 22. The four PD early-release dates are attendance dates, not full staff-only days. Expand the two explicit semester-end early-release ranges into daily canonical occurrences; partition dates are derived, while published quarter/last-day endpoints remain official. December 18 combines early release, grading and semester end. May 28 combines last day, early release, grading and semester end. October 9 and March 12 are regular-length grading ends. Do not add exam classifications without a published exam schedule. Keep the exact named break ranges November 23-27, December 21-January 1 and March 15-19. Partition Thanksgiving into individual November 23/24 conditional reserve occurrences and the derived fixed November 25-27 segment; partition spring identically into March 15/16 reserves and March 17-19 fixed segment. Each date is stored once. Retain the complete named range in breaks/keyDates with reserve caveats; do not mark all five days conditional or treat two reserve dates as guaranteed closures. Conditional dates use the published no-class baseline, mayBecomeAttendanceDay and no absolute attendance flag. January 5 and March 23 returns are derived; the PDF does not explicitly state them as return entries. March 23-25 remain scheduled attendance days before the separately named Long weekend on March 26. The four printed quarter figures total 180 (43+42+47+48), a derived annual sum matching 209 weekdays minus 25 fixed closures and 4 conditional no-class reserve weekdays. The fixed no-school statistic excludes reserves; it is not the full planned 29-day exclusion. The 23 school bell rows come from the separate Board-approved March 24, 2026 table. Interpret the start column as morning instruction, ordinary end as afternoon dismissal, and early-release times before noon as a.m./later times as p.m.; keep drop-off separate in row notes. Do not apply the bell-table approval date to the annual calendar. Eastside is labeled ES in that table; its own page describes an elementary 9 a.m.-3:40 p.m. day and includes arrival at 8:40 a.m. in its broader hours block. Retain its row scope without extending an elementary timetable to an unverified grade program. The Calendar page’s March 10 document label and PDF export metadata do not prove Board adoption or an official revision date.
about.updates: Verified October 19, 2026 against the current Calendar and District Bell Schedule pages and linked PDFs. District homepage news and Nature Coast school announcements were reviewed for operating changes. No confirmed activation of the four hurricane reserves or a later districtwide schedule revision was verified. Some newer Nature Coast weekly-news entries appeared in search results but their linked full notices were not consistently retrievable; no additional shortened date was inferred from a flyer headline. Direct HTML fetches sometimes failed, while the official PDF downloads and web reader remained accessible.
about.disclaimer: Check district and school announcements before relying on hurricane reserve dates for travel. School-specific exam, program, transportation and later schedule notices may require different arrangements.

faqs.question: When does school start and end in Hernando County?
faqs.answer: Students start Tuesday, August 11, 2026 and finish Friday, May 28, 2027. The last day has early release. The earlier August 4-7 and August 10 preparation dates are for staff, not the first days of preschool or regular student classes.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break, and can any of it become school days?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break is November 23-27, 2026. November 23 and 24 are also designated hurricane make-up dates, so those two days may become attendance days if the district activates them. If they remain unused, students are off November 21-29 including weekends, with a scheduled Monday, November 30 return.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a professional day without student classes, so the next scheduled student day is Tuesday, January 5. Including weekends, the planned time off is December 19-January 4, a 17-day stretch.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and is Monday afterward a student holiday?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 15-19, 2027, with March 15-16 reserved for possible hurricane make-up. Monday, March 22 is a separate teacher professional day, so students are scheduled to return Tuesday, March 23. If the reserves remain unused, the full time off is March 13-22.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday?
faqs.answer: No student classes are scheduled Friday, March 26, 2027, which the district labels Long weekend. Students are scheduled to attend March 23-25 between spring break’s return and this separate holiday, then return Monday, March 29 after the long weekend.

faqs.question: Which dates have early release?
faqs.answer: There are ten listed dates: August 28, September 25 and December 16-18, 2026; January 29, February 26 and May 26-28, 2027. The August, September, January and February dates are for professional development. The December and May dates are the semester-end early releases.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal at my school?
faqs.answer: The approved table lists Hernando High at 11:20 a.m.; D.S. Parrott at 11 a.m.; Central, Nature Coast, Springstead and Weeki Wachee at 11:10 a.m.; Endeavor at 11:05 a.m. Brooksville, the Eastside ES row and Moton release at 12:40 p.m. Explorer, Winding Waters, Fox Chapel, Powell and West Hernando release at 12:10 p.m.; Challenger at 12:55 p.m. Chocachatti, Deltona, Floyd, Pine Grove, Spring Hill, Suncoast and Westside release at 1:10 p.m. Confirm separate program or exam arrangements with the school.

faqs.question: How early can students be dropped off?
faqs.answer: Use the drop-off column in the 2026-2027 bell schedule; it is separate from the class start time. For example, Hernando High allows drop-off at 7 a.m. for a 7:20 a.m. start, and D.S. Parrott allows 7:10 a.m. for a 7:30 a.m. start. The school-hours rows give each listed campus’s drop-off, regular hours and early dismissal.

faqs.question: Which professional days have no school for students?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes October 12 and October 30, 2026, then January 4 and March 22, 2027. October 30 is district in-service. The four professional-development early-release dates are shortened attendance days rather than full student holidays.

faqs.question: Is the Friday before Halloween a school day?
faqs.answer: Friday, October 30, 2026 is district in-service, with students not in attendance. With the weekend, students are off October 30-November 1 and are scheduled to return Monday, November 2.

faqs.question: Which hurricane make-up dates are listed?
faqs.answer: The four designated dates are November 23-24, 2026 and March 15-16, 2027. They are currently part of Thanksgiving and spring breaks, not automatically required class days. Follow district announcements to learn whether any reserve dates will be used, and check before making firm travel plans.

faqs.question: Are Labor Day, Veterans Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents Day holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are off September 7 and November 11, 2026, and January 18 and February 15, 2027. The calendar does not list the next Tuesdays as additional holidays.

faqs.question: When do the grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 9 and December 18, 2026, then March 12 and May 28, 2027. December 18 and May 28 have early release. October 9 and March 12 are regular-length student days on this calendar.

faqs.question: How many student days are scheduled for the year?
faqs.answer: The four printed grading-period counts add up to 180 days: 43 + 42 + 47 + 48. That is a calculated annual total, not a separate annual figure printed in the PDF. It matches the current date grid with all four hurricane reserves still unused; weather closures and make-up decisions may change the operating schedule.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar and check updates?
faqs.answer: The district’s School Calendars page links the 2026-2027 Student Calendar, alongside separate teacher and employee calendars. Use the student version for family planning and check district and school announcements for any later changes. The separate District Bell Schedule page provides the school-specific clock times.

faqs.question: Is the calendar available in Spanish or Haitian Creole?
faqs.answer: The district says its downloadable documents are ADA accessible and available in Spanish, Haitian Creole and other languages once opened. Check the document’s language and accessibility options from the official School Calendars page.
